changes: I rewrote `/agent/solver.md`. The agent used only about 3 of its 16 model calls, and 19 of the 34 failures submitted programs that fail the public examples. The new prompt requires running the public examples before any submit and never submitting a failing program. It also asks for a short hand-derivation before coding. After the examples pass, it asks for a brute-force comparison on small random inputs and a max-size timing check. This is aimed at the wrong-answer and time-limit failures. `validate()` returned OK. I did not run any trials, so the effect is untested.
